physicalNotes: Radius 0.17396735 Jupiter radii from Palle et al. 2019 (2019A&A...623A..41P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract): 12,437.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Palle et al. 2019 (2019A&A...623A..41P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...623A..41P/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.0336658 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
